sections.title: Kaitech
sections.body: Software that keeps Fiji business moving. Four live products for paying people, sending invoices, checking the work and getting deliveries out.

sections.tag: Product 1 of 4 · payroll and HR · live
sections.title: KaiWorkforce
sections.body: Payroll and HR for staffing agencies. FNPF and PAYE are worked out for you, staff clock in at their work site, and payslips go out by email.
sections.seo: KaiWorkforce is payroll and HR software for staffing agencies in Fiji: FNPF and PAYE worked out for you, clock-in at the work site, and payslips by email.
points: Payroll that knows Fiji
FNPF and PAYE are calculated from your configured rates every pay run. Bonuses, allowances, rate changes, tax adjustments and termination pay are handled in the same run.
Clock-in where the work is
Staff clock in and out at their work site. Supervisors see who is on site on a live map, and the hours flow straight into timesheets.
Payslips without the printing
When the pay run is done, every employee gets their payslip by email.
Built for agencies
Each agency gets its own private workspace, with leave, timesheets, work sites, an org chart and an audit log of every change.

sections.title: BillZilla
sections.body: Invoicing for Fiji businesses. Quotes become invoices with gap-free numbers, stock moves when you finalise, and customers get statements and reminders.

screens.caption: An invoice with its payments, credit note and reminders
The dashboard: what is outstanding, overdue and waiting for approval

sections.seo: BillZilla is invoicing software for Fiji businesses: quotes, invoices and credit notes with gap-free numbering, M-PAiSA and MyCash payments, stock and statements.
points: Quotes to invoices, in order
A quote becomes an invoice in one step. Numbers are given when you finalise, so there are never gaps, and every invoice uses one of seven A4 layouts with your logo.
Paid the way Fiji pays
Record bank transfers, cash, cash on delivery, cheques, M-PAiSA and MyCash, including part payments.
Stock that keeps up
Stock moves when an invoice is finalised, voided or credited, and load sheets are ready for the delivery run.
Chasing done for you
Customers get emailed invoices, statements and automatic payment reminders. Prices below a product's minimum wait for the owner's approval.

sections.title: KaiInspect
sections.body: Cleaning quality control for facility services companies. An auditor marks each room Pass or Fail, every Fail needs a photo, and the cleaner sends back a photo of the fix.
sections.seo: KaiInspect is cleaning quality control software for facility services companies in Fiji: room-by-room inspections, photo proof of fixes and customer reports.
points: Room by room
An auditor walks the site and marks each checklist item Pass or Fail. Every Fail needs a photo and becomes a problem with a due date.
Works with no signal
The inspection saves on the phone after every tap and sends when the signal comes back.
Fixes with proof
The cleaner gets a WhatsApp link, opens it with no account, and photographs the fix. The auditor approves it or sends it back.
Reports for both sides
Customers get a clean report link. The company gets the full detail: every item, photo, time to fix and the most repeated problems.

sections.title: Drivo
sections.body: Delivery routing and fleet tracking for distribution companies. Dispatchers plan routes from confirmed invoices, drivers navigate in the app, and every vehicle shows live.

screens.caption: Planning a route from invoices ready for delivery
Route settings: depot, vehicle and what to optimise for

sections.seo: Drivo is delivery routing and fleet tracking for Fiji distribution companies: routes from confirmed invoices, in-app navigation, proof of delivery and live vehicles.
points: Routes from invoices
Choose confirmed invoices, compare three route options, then assign a driver and vehicle. Optimise for fuel, time or distance.
Drivers stay in one app
Drivers navigate inside Drivo, record proof of delivery and drop pins for new shops.
See every vehicle
Dispatchers watch vehicles live and see where each run is up to.
Fiji's own roads
Maps and routing run on open-source tools built from Fiji's road data, with no paid map fees to pass on. Drivo connects to BillZilla and KaiWorkforce when you use them.
